SANKALP_Intro: The Pramukh SANKALP Programme is a visionary leadership development and Civil Services foundation programme designed for school students of Standard 6 to 12. It aims to nurture ethical, disciplined, and service-driven future leaders and officers, who contribute meaningfully to society and align with the national vision of Viksit Bharat. Rooted in Indian ethos, values, and Sanatan wisdom, the programme focuses on the balanced development of Head (Knowledge), Heart (Values), and Hand (Skills).
Purpose_Desc: This application form is meant only for individual students of Std. 6 to 12 who wish to join the SANKALP Programme independently (online mode).
Voluntary_Desc: By filling this form, you confirm that you are joining the programme voluntarily, with full understanding and consent of your parent/guardian.
Orientation_Desc: The SANKALP Programme draws inspiration from Indian Vedic culture, Sanatan scriptures, and value-based leadership principles, while remaining relevant to modern education and leadership needs.
